messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: INC-2026-8932 triggered by backend.latency.service (threshold breach). Urgency: high. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/latency
alice oncall: saw this — paging in #oncall. I'm pulling up metrics.
alice oncall: grafana link https://grafana.redwood.local/d/abc/latency?from=now-15m to=now
alice oncall: 95th p95 spiking from 120ms -> 850ms for text-generation endpoint
darren sre: was there a deploy in the last 30m? checking deploy bot...
deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-14-rtp rolled to canary at 1768004200 by @ci
alice oncall: canary -> looks like increased tail latency coincident w/ canary
bob secondary: pinged — firing up additional pods and pulling logs
alice oncall: acked in PD :white_check_mark:
bob secondary: attempting to scale up models-service: `kubectl -n prod scale deployment models-service --replicas=8`
bob secondary: logs show `KV cache resize failure` repeated:
```
E 14:23:10 kv_cache.cc:103 FailedToAllocate: Requested 2.1Gi but only 1.6Gi available
E 14:23:11 runtime.cpp:452 kernel_selector: fallback to slower kernel
```
carol manager: paging me (escalation policy fired) — what customer impact?
eve support: CS reporting increased API 429s from customer acme-co. They see ~30% of requests timing out and retrying
alice oncall: customer-visible errors: timeouts 504 and 429 due to queue saturation; estimated affected customers: 3 paying customers, small spike in free tier
darren sre: looks like memory pressure on GPU nodes caused evictions; autoscaler didn't add nodes quickly enough
alice oncall: I'm opening incident ticket INC-2026-8932 in Zendesk and linking PD
alice oncall: Assigning sev P1
carol manager: if PD didn't get acked we need manual voice escalation — did PD page manager? it did.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation to manager triggered (policy: primary-10m->secondary-5m->manager), manager page sent to carol.manager@redwood.com
alice oncall: PD shows missed-ack from primary (alice) after 8m; secondary (bob) acknowledged at 1768004305, but some escalations already fired
bob secondary: scaled pods, but model runtime still hitting allocation errors. rolling back canary to previous model variant now: `kubectl -n prod set image deployment/models-service models=redwood/models:2026-03-14-previous`
bob secondary: issuing graceful restart for canary nodes
alice oncall: triggering fallback routing: route requests to smaller-quantized model variant to reduce memory usage — activating policy `route=low-memory-variants`
darren sre: coordinating with infra to drain one unhealthy node and add capacity — `gcloud compute instances create gpu-pool-6 --zone=us-west1-b --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g` (started)
eve support: notifying affected customers: posting to ACME support thread, offering mitigation steps and ETA
carol manager: good. please post a short incident summary here and assign follow-ups: root cause, remediation, long-term fix
alice oncall: summary draft: "Canary deploy of new runtime kernels caused increased GPU memory allocation failures -> KV cache allocations failed -> tail latency spike -> queue saturation -> customer timeouts". Actions: rollback canary, scale up nodes, add autoscaler tuning, add extra monitoring for KV allocation metrics
bob secondary: confirmed rollback completed at 1768004410
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-2026-8932 acknowledged by bob secondary at 1768004305. Status: acknowledged -> resolved? (still recovering)
alice oncall: monitoring — p95 back down to 180ms, 504s dropping. will keep the channel until fully stable
darren sre: scheduled postmortem meeting for tomorrow 10:00am PST
carol manager: assign owners: follow-up on autoscale tuning -> darren; model runtime memory checks -> bob; customer follow-up -> eve
eve support: done, CS notified customers, sent credits offer
alice oncall: handing off to bob for night coverage — I'm off shift in 30m :wave:
bob secondary: copy. I'll continue monitoring and will page if anything recurs
incident-bot: channel archived when thread resolved
